description: The file 'planImport.php' is a PHP script that handles the import of test plan links in XML format within the TestLink open-source testing management system. It includes PHP code for handling file uploads, parsing XML data, linking test cases to test plans, and managing related entities like platforms and test cases.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: A class managing test plans, including linking test case versions and getting platform info.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class for managing test projects, including counting test cases and retrieving associated data.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: A class handling platform entities within test plans.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: A class for managing test case data, including retrieving info and linked versions.

methods.name: importTestPlanLinksFromXML
methods.description: Parses an XML file to import test plan links, associating test cases with a test plan and platforms.

methods.name: processPlatforms
methods.description: Processes platform elements in the XML to link or verify platforms within the test plan context.
